notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474394/b051a62b42a673aa8b443258e3b8fa9956f1b488.png

Note: This update is not compatible with old save game files.

Features

Campfire park area as a meta-progression hub
A blacksmith NPC who upgrades equipment for a price (if you find their anvil)
Philosopher's Stone reusable item (granted to new characters)
Sanctuary Talisman consumable item
Mace weapon class
New equipment: Mace, Morning Star, Blacksmith Hammer, Blacksmith Tongs, Blacksmith Apron
Miscellaneous small usability improvements


Bugfixes

Fixed a bug causing lock doors to be improperly offset at some rotations, causing pattern breakages and unnecessary map generation delays
Miscellaneous small bugfixes

notes.title: Azoth & Ignis Update 0.1.8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474394/a738a89e7a74f85e03ac181377f62614ba90a890.png

Azoth & Ignis was released last night into early access. The following changes have been made to the game since the prerelease gameplay trailer was recorded.

Features

Enemy patrols
Improved enemy AI including evasion behaviors and distinct combat "personalities"
Improved combat mechanics including knockback, momentum, hit response
Improved combat controls allowing turn in place while casting or attacking
Aurum Spindle item which guides to the source of the gold curse (see image)
Pathfinding functionality in general
Visual feedback when using the HUD cross buttons
Add evasion animation. All references to "roll" are now "evade"
Camera has initial orientation toward the next door on load/spawn
Preview appearance options before final selection
Preload all materials when the game starts, to avoid flashbang effects when loading to GPU
Enemies wait until rooms are activated to start acting
Add file load error handling


Bugfixes

Doors shouldn't close when the player walks far away
Count room total enemies/deaths including on inactive tiles
Active enemies shouldn't disappear if home tile unloads
Use of joystick on virtual keyboard
Steam Deck should show right glyphs
Anti-aliased fonts
Improve legibility of the scroll font, which should now be bold and readable
Level up confirm must require selection
Disallow evade while encumbered
Stop feet stamping animation while standing in place, in some situations
Improve hitboxes on sword and balance animation timings
Apply correct target frame rate for garbage collection, according to display frame rate
Active status effect icons on the HUD should disappear when returning to the main menu
